name: AraBench Test — Dialectal Arabic ↔ English
description: Dialectal Arabic ↔ English MT evaluation from QCRI's AraBench. Adds an Arabic-dialect axis: Modern Standard Arabic (arb/msa), North Levantine (apc/lev), Gulf (afb/glf), Maghrebi (ary/mgr), and Egyptian/Nile (arz/nil), each paired with English in both directions. The Champollion adapter aggregates only the full-text public components (MADAR, Bible, QAraC) per dialect — it never ingests the LDC-restricted segments (AraBench ships those as ID-only sidecars). QUARANTINED: AraBench's license composition is not clearly commercial-safe (MADAR is research-use; some components are LDC-derived), so this set is catalogued and buildable on demand but held OUT of the open contribution queue pending a docs/LICENSING.md review. Domain 'mixed': the adapter aggregates MADAR (travel/everyday → conv), Bible (religious) and QAraC (Quran comprehension → religious/edu); domainDistribution is an approximate documented estimate. 'religious' is honest labelling only, never a coverage credit (and AraBench is quarantined regardless).
quarantineReason: License review 2026-08-24: HELD. No single upstream license: AraBench aggregates MADAR (research-use terms), Bible text, and QAraC as full text; LDC-derived components ship as IDs only. Mixed research-use terms are never interpreted on the rights-holders' behalf. Catalogued; excluded from the queue, contests, and ranking (DB trigger, migration 022); remote transmission refused (consent-required). Clears component-wise as terms are verified, or by a recorded grant.

segments.name: AraBench Test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — dialectal Arabic ↔ English test sentences aggregated per dialect

download.instructions: Download AraBench_dataset.tgz. Files are {source}.{split}.{dialect}.{n}.{region}.{ar|en}; each .ar has a sibling .en (line-aligned). The adapter aggregates all .test.{dialect}.*.ar/.en files per dialect (MADAR/Bible/QAraC), sorted by name. The LDC-restricted segments ship as *.ids sidecars (IDs only) and are deliberately NOT ingested.

source.publisher: QCRI (Qatar Computing Research Institute) — Arabic Language Technologies
source.citation: Sajjad et al. (2020). AraBench: Benchmarking Dialectal Arabic-English Machine Translation. COLING 2020. Components: MADAR (Bouamor et al. 2018), Bible, QAraC (Elmahdy et al. 2014), APT/LDC2012T09 (Zbib et al. 2012, IDs only).

license.notes: No single permissive SPDX license. AraBench aggregates MADAR (research-use), Bible, and QAraC as full text, plus LDC-derived data provided as IDs only. Commercial/redistribution status of the full-text components is unverified — treated as NON-commercial-safe and quarantined until reviewed.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Quarantined pending license review. Builds on demand (research/eval) but is excluded from the open contribution queue and any commercial path.

contamination.reasoning: AraBench components (MADAR travel-domain, Bible, QAraC) are publicly available and have circulated in the dialectal-Arabic NLP community since 2018-2020; portions may appear in web-crawled training data. Dialectal Arabic is less represented in frontier training sets than MSA, so contamination is moderate rather than high.
